result.title: JustOPD: On-Policy Distillation from Autoregressive to Diffusion Language Models
result.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a post-training approach for large language models (LLMs) that enables a student model to learn a teacher model's distribution from sequences sampled from the student's own policy. Despite its promising capability, OPD for diffusion language models (DLMs) remains underexplored and existing studies primarily focuses on DLM-to-DLM distillation. The limited availability of strong teacher DLMs and the flexible generation order of DLMs impose additional technical challenges as well. However, it remains unclear how to effectively distill knowledge from a strong autoregressive language model (ARM) into a weaker DLM, given the mismatch between the left-to-right decoding of ARMs and the flexible decoding order of DLMs. Inspired by Ni et al. (2026), we propose JustOPD, an ARM-to-DLM on-policy distillation method that uses autoregressive rollouts during training to align the student's generation process with the ARM teacher's left-to-right decoding. This alignment enables effective distillation from ARM teachers while preserving the DLM's flexible generation-order capability at inference time. Experiments using Qwen3-14B as the teacher and Dream-7B as the student demonstrate that JustOPD consistently improves mathematical reasoning performance over the base DLM across multiple divergence choices.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 JustOPD，一种从自回归语言模型到扩散语言模型的 on-policy 蒸馏方法：训练时用自回归 rollout 让学生的生成过程对齐教师的从左到右解码，从而在推理阶段仍保留 DLM 的灵活生成顺序，并在数学推理上稳定优于基座 DLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本工作，但其「跨解码顺序差异做蒸馏对齐、且不牺牲推理期并行/任意顺序生成」的思路，可能为用 AR 教师训练 parallel 或 diffusion 式 latent 推理状态生成器提供监督与轨迹对齐线索，可供核查。
